categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Lacks the Build system label and touches only contrib/verify-binaries, which is a standalone user-facing script rather than part of the build, CI, or release-generation pipeline.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Carries the Scripts and tools label and modifies contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py, the script used to verify release binaries.
categories.rationale: Fixes a critical security logic flaw where untrusted and revoked signatures satisfied the required verification threshold. In verify.py, num_trusted was incorrectly computed as len(good_trusted) + len(good_untrusted), allowing any valid signature in a local GPG keyring to pass threshold verification without matching trusted keys.
